// This is the throwaway program that made testdata/cases.json: it runs the old core's payload
// engine on every case and stores what it returned in the case's "old" field. Kept as text so it
// is not compiled here. To regenerate (after changing or adding a case in cases.json):
//
//   1. make a worktree of a commit that has core/ (once core/ is removed from the repository, the
//      last commit that has it, named in next/corpus/README.md):
//        git worktree add <tmp> <commit>
//   2. copy this file to <tmp>/core/internal/runtime/executor/helps/zz_oldengine_gen_test.go
//   3. from <tmp>/core, with CGO_ENABLED=1:
//        PLUXY_GEN_IN=<abs>/next/sdk/payload/testdata/cases.json PLUXY_GEN_OUT=/tmp/cases_out.json \
//          go test -p 2 -count=1 -run TestZZOldEngineGen ./internal/runtime/executor/helps/
//   4. replace testdata/cases.json with /tmp/cases_out.json, and remove the worktree
//      (git worktree remove --force <tmp>)
//
// A case whose result depends on the order of a rule's params (a Go map in the old engine) fails
// the run as not deterministic: change such a case so one rule never creates two new keys at once.
// Keep User-Agent out of case headers: the old engine rewrites Codex tool integers for a Codex
// client, which is not a payload rule.

package helps

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"testing"

	"github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/v8/internal/config"
)

// Throwaway generator: runs the old payload engine on the cases in PLUXY_GEN_IN and writes the
// outputs to PLUXY_GEN_OUT. See next/sdk/payload/testdata/oldengine_gen.go.txt.

type zzInput struct {
	Model          string              `json:"model"`
	RequestedModel string              `json:"requested-model"`
	Protocol       string              `json:"protocol"`
	FromProtocol   string              `json:"from-protocol"`
	Root           string              `json:"root"`
	Headers        map[string][]string `json:"headers"`
	Original       *string             `json:"original"`
}

type zzCase struct {
	Name     string               `json:"name"`
	Rules    config.PayloadConfig `json:"rules"`
	Input    zzInput              `json:"input"`
	Body     string               `json:"body"`
	Semantic bool                 `json:"semantic,omitempty"`
	Note     string               `json:"note,omitempty"`
	Old      string               `json:"old"`
}

func TestZZOldEngineGen(t *testing.T) {
	inPath, outPath := os.Getenv("PLUXY_GEN_IN"), os.Getenv("PLUXY_GEN_OUT")
	if inPath == "" || outPath == "" {
		t.Skip("PLUXY_GEN_IN and PLUXY_GEN_OUT not set")
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(inPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var cases []zzCase
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &cases); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	run := func(c *zzCase) string {
		cfg := &config.Config{Payload: c.Rules}
		var original []byte
		if c.Input.Original != nil {
			original = []byte(*c.Input.Original)
		}
		h := http.Header{}
		for k, vs := range c.Input.Headers {
			for _, v := range vs {
				h.Add(k, v)
			}
		}
		out := ApplyPayloadConfigWithRequest(cfg, c.Input.Model, c.Input.Protocol, c.Input.FromProtocol, c.Input.Root, []byte(c.Body), original, c.Input.RequestedModel, "", h)
		return string(out)
	}
	for i := range cases {
		c := &cases[i]
		c.Old = run(c)
		// Params is a Go map, so the old engine's order inside one rule is random: a case whose
		// result depends on it is a bad case.
		for n := 0; n < 40; n++ {
			if again := run(c); again != c.Old {
				t.Errorf("case %q is not deterministic: %q then %q", c.Name, c.Old, again)
				break
			}
		}
	}
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	enc := json.NewEncoder(&buf)
	enc.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
	if err := enc.Encode(cases); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(outPath, buf.Bytes(), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
